text: Rabbitoids: the void has room for one apex predator. Dig your warrens deep - Iron Fist is coming.

The Loom greets you, Humanoid. This galaxy holds 196 worlds - thread enough for two tapestries. I propose we weave apart: your fleets keep east, mine keep west, and neither wastes blood. Cross my line, and the pattern changes.
The Iron Fist finds your thread acceptable, Loom. Keep your fleets west and weave in peace - my business lies east. But know this: cross the line first, and you will learn what iron does to thread.

Commander: the galaxy is wide and my people patient. I have no quarrel with the Humanoids - keep your fleets east of the 300-ly meridian and mine will never trouble you. Weavers remember both threads and cuts.
Agreed, Weaver. The east feeds my people well - I have no appetite for western threads. Tend your loom in peace, and we need never test whose cut runs deeper.
